SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE
UPPER ENDOSCOPIC ULTRASOUND (EUS) REPORT
Facility: Fairhaven Digestive Institute (fictional)
Patient: Ingrid Solberg-Marsh (fictional)
Date of service: November 6, 2026
Endoscopist: Thaddeus Ng, MD (fictional)
Indication: Dilated common bile duct on abdominal ultrasound; evaluate for choledocholithiasis.
Procedure: The linear echoendoscope was advanced to the second portion of the duodenum.
EUS imaging was performed from the esophagus, stomach and duodenum.
Findings: common bile duct 7 mm without stones or sludge; the ampulla was normal.
Pancreas: normal echotexture with no mass or cyst. No lymphadenopathy.
Fine-needle aspiration was not performed because no target lesion was found.
Impression: Mildly dilated common bile duct without choledocholithiasis on EUS.
Plan: Clinic follow-up with repeat liver tests.
